selection_approach_display.default: Anglia Ruskin checks academic and SJT eligibility; eligible Home applicants are ranked by adjusted UCAT after verified percentage uplifts, while verified care-experienced or Free School Meals applicants may receive a guaranteed interview.

by_applicant_pool.aru_home_standard_guidance: Anglia Ruskin checks academic and SJT eligibility, then ranks eligible Home applicants by UCAT score.
by_applicant_pool.aru_home_uplift_guidance: Anglia Ruskin checks academic and SJT eligibility, then ranks eligible Home applicants by adjusted UCAT after verified WAMS or regional percentage uplifts.
by_applicant_pool.aru_graduate_same_a100_pool_guidance: Anglia Ruskin checks academic and SJT eligibility, then ranks eligible graduate A100 applicants by UCAT score within the same A100 process.

course.name: MBChB Medicine
course.notes: ARU A100 accepts Home-fee applicants only. Graduate applicants apply through the same A100 admissions process and remain in the same applicant pool; this profile must not be treated as a separate graduate-entry route.

medical_school.name: Anglia Ruskin School of Medicine
medical_school.faculty: Faculty of Health, Medicine and Social Care
medical_school.notes: Rules are mapped from ARU.docx, supplied as the authoritative implementation specification.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Eligible Home applicants are ranked for interview by UCAT cognitive score after any applicable percentage uplifts. Standard applicants receive no uplift.

WAMS, East of England and Essex applicants remain in the same A100 pool but may receive percentage UCAT uplifts. WAMS may stack with one regional uplift; Essex takes precedence over East of England. No flat regional point values are used.
Care-experienced/Care Leaver or Free School Meals applicants receive a guaranteed interview only after the implemented academic thresholds and SJT Band 1-3 conditions are met.

overall_policy.description: ARU checks academic minimums, requires UCAT and rejects SJT Band 4. Academics are not competitively scored after threshold checks.
not_eligible_if: The applicable academic minimum requirements are not met.
The applicant has International/Overseas fee status.

accepted_equivalencies: Combined Science or Double Award at 55/BB may satisfy the two-science requirement.
gcse.sitting_policy: No separate GCSE resit policy is published in the supplied ARU specification.
gcse.notes: GCSEs are a strict pass/fail threshold. Higher GCSE grades are not scored after the minimum is met.

contextual_offer.notes: WAMS applicants may receive an ABB A-level threshold.

a_level.notes: A-levels must be achieved within three academic years of application. Resit applicants must meet the first-sitting policy documented under resits.

ib.notes: IB route is documented in the ARU specification but remains a manual-review boundary in this implementation unless complete official subject-grade execution data is supplied.

scottish.notes: Scottish route is documented in the ARU specification but remains a manual-review boundary in this implementation.

post_16.notes: Automatic execution is limited to the A-level route because ARU.docx supplied enough exact A-level thresholds for deterministic checking.

ucat.minimum_total_score_basis: ARU uses UCAT ranking and published working thresholds. No fixed universal eligibility cut-off is encoded; low UCAT applicants remain eligible but may receive high-risk guidance unless a documented guaranteed-interview override applies.

scoring.notes: SJT is a filter only and is not scored for interview ranking.

resits.policy: Applicants must have achieved at least AAB at first sitting, or BBB if WAMS eligible. If AAA has already been achieved in a resit, the first-sitting requirement is waived.
resits.conditions: Applicant-specific resit evidence may require manual review because the shared classifier can only apply the generic first-sitting profile check.

Other ARU WAMS criteria documented in the supplied specification
adjustments: Care-experienced/Care Leaver and Free School Meals: guaranteed interview only when academics and SJT Band 1-3 are met
contextual.notes: WAMS may stack with the single applicable regional percentage uplift. Essex takes precedence over East of England; do not invent flat regional point values.

english_language.notes: International applicants are not eligible for ARU A100 in this implementation.

age_or_degree.notes: Graduates are accepted through the same A100 process and same applicant pool, subject to the published graduate-category UCAT context and standard academic requirements.

age_or_professional_checks.work_or_service_experience: Recommended and may be discussed at MMI, but not scored for interview shortlisting.
age_or_professional_checks.personal_statement: Submitted through UCAS and may be used as a basis for MMI discussion; not scored for interview shortlisting.
age_or_professional_checks.reference_policy: Standard UCAS academic or professional reference required; not scored for interview shortlisting.

non_academic.notes: Non-academic evidence is not used to compute ApplySmart interview prediction.

ranking_factors.notes: Applicants are ranked by UCAT cognitive score after eligible percentage uplifts. Academics are pass/fail only; SJT is a filter only.

score_components.notes: WAMS adds 5%. Regional uplift is exclusive by precedence: Essex adds 5%, otherwise East of England adds 2.5%, otherwise 0%. WAMS may stack with the selected regional uplift. No flat regional point values are used.

total_score.notes: Academics are pass/fail only and SJT is a gate only. The adjusted UCAT score is used for interview guidance, not offer prediction.

calculation.notes: The model is representable as adjusted UCAT ranking after pass/fail academic and SJT gates.

selection_adjustments.notes: WAMS applicants receive a 5% UCAT uplift.
East of England applicants receive a 2.5% UCAT uplift unless the Essex regional uplift also applies.
Essex applicants receive a 5% UCAT uplift instead of the East of England regional uplift.

quotas_or_pools.notes: School-leavers and graduates apply through the same A100 process and remain in the same applicant pool. Historical graduate threshold guidance is labelled separately but is not a separate course route.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: International applicants are not eligible. Final offers are based solely on MMI ranking, but ApplySmart does not provide offer prediction.

wams.notes: WAMS uplift stacks with the single applicable regional uplift.

offer_selection.interview_format: In-person Multiple Mini Interview at the Chelmsford School of Medicine building; six stations with seven minutes per station and one minute reading time.

interview_scoring.notes: Each station is marked for quality of answer, skills/qualities and communication. Global station scores may be used as a tie-breaker.

offer_selection.offer_model: Offers are based solely on MMI ranking.

tie_breakers.notes: Global station scores are used when candidates have the same numerical MMI score.

standard_offer.notes: Offer conditions are included for transparency only and are not offer prediction.

offer_selection.applysmart_policy: ApplySmart must not predict offers, MMI score, waiting list position, or offer probability.
offer_selection.notes: UCAT and academics do not directly determine final offers after interview shortlisting.

validation.review_notes: Production ARU A100 implementation supports Home A-level applicants, WAMS/regional UCAT percentage uplifts, SJT Band 4 rejection, and documented guaranteed-interview subgroups. International applicants are explicitly blocked.

engine_assumptions: Automatic execution is scoped to Home A-level applicants with complete GCSE, A-level, UCAT and SJT evidence.
ARU-specific WAMS, East of England, Essex and Free School Meals flags are supplied to the classifier as applicant group/contextual flags.
Graduates remain in the same A100 process when standard A100 academic evidence is supplied.
do_not_infer: Do not invent flat regional point values.
Do not make International applicants eligible.
Do not create a separate graduate A100 pool.
Do not predict offers, MMI score, waiting-list position or offer probability.
engine_execution_boundaries: Automatic eligibility execution is limited to the supported A-level route with complete GCSE, UCAT and SJT evidence.
WAMS, East of England and Essex percentage UCAT uplifts are executable. WAMS stacks with one regional uplift; Essex takes precedence over East of England.
Care-experienced/Care Leaver and Free School Meals guaranteed-interview handling applies only after academic thresholds and SJT Band 1-3 pass.
Offer prediction remains out of scope.
